newsitem.title: GERMANY: Bayer reports softer Q4 1996 profits.
newsitem.headline: Bayer reports softer Q4 1996 profits.

text.p: German chemicals and drugs group Bayer AG said on Tuesday that its pre-tax profit fell 13 percent to 760 million marks in the fourth quarter of 1996.

"The pre-tax profit for the fourth quarter 1996 was 760 million marks," said Bayer management board chairman Manfred Schneider, noting that this result also included an unexpected fine paid in the U.S.
The group had an exceptional charge of 150 million marks to settle antitrust litigation involving pricing of citric acid in the U.S. Schneider said.
Bayer's rival Hoechst posted a loss in the fourth quarter 1996 as it also incurred extraordinary charges stemming from product recalls and restructuring costs.
